text: Semiconductor equities advanced sharply across Asia following stronger-than-expected cloud earnings from major U.S. technology firms. SK Hynix gained nearly 30%, Samsung Electronics nearly 27%, TSMC nearly 10%, and the iShares Semiconductor ETF rose more than 8%, reversing losses from earlier in the week.

meta.note: The structural event is the broad repricing of AI-related semiconductor equities across markets; analyst commentary is excluded.
